kjv: And Satan stood up against Israel
mine: Then an adversary stood against Israel
note: satan here has no article, unlike haSatan ("the accuser") in Job and Zechariah, so it may be a proper name or simply "an adversary". The parallel 2 Sam 24:1 says Yahweh incited David. The KJV's proper name settles a question the Hebrew leaves open.

kjv: he repented him of the evil
note: wayyinnachem 'al-hara'ah means "he relented concerning the disaster". "Repented of the evil" now suggests God had done moral wrong.
